Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Tamar_1: wife of Er (Genesis 38:6), and mother of Perez (Genesis 38:29) and Zerah (Genesis 38:30) by Judah
Hezron_2: son of Perez and grandson of Judah (Genesis 46:12)
Nahshon_1: son of Amminadab and brother of Elisheba (Exodus 6:23), head of the tribe of Judah during the census (Numbers 1:7)
Boaz_1: kinsman of Naomi's husband (Ruth 2:1) who redeemed Ruth (Ruth 4:10)
Obed_1: son of Ruth and father of Jesse (Ruth 4:17)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Ram_1: son of Hezron in the lineage of King David (Ruth 4:19)
Salmon_1: son of Nahshon and father of Boaz in the lineage of King David (Ruth 4:19)
Bathsheba_1: daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah (2 Samuel 11:3)
Uriah_1: the Hittite (2 Samuel 11:3), thirty-seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:39)
Rehoboam_1: son of Solomon who became king after him (1 Kings 11:43)
Josiah_1: prophesied son of the house of David (1 Kings 13:2), King of Judah and son of Amon (2 Kings 21:24)
Abijam_1: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam (1 Kings 14:31) [Abijah in 2 Chronicles 12:16]
Asa_1: King of Judah (1 Kings 15:9), son of incestuous relationship between Abijah and his mother, Maacah (1 Kings 15:10)
Jehoshaphat_3: son of Asa and King of Judah (1 Kings 15:24)
Jehoram_1: King of Judah and son of Jehoshaphat (1 Kings 22:50)
Azariah_3: [Uzziah] King of Judah, son of Amaziah (2 Kings 14:21)
Jotham_2: King of Judah, son of King Uzziah [Azariah_3] (2 Kings 15:30)
Ahaz_1: King of Judah, son of Jotham (2 Kings 15:38)
Hezekiah_1: King of Judah, son of Ahaz (2 Kings 16:20)
Manasseh_3: King of Judah and son of Hezekiah (2 Kings 20:21)
Amon_2: King of Judah and son of Manasseh (2 Kings 21:18)
Jehoiachin_1: King of Judah, son of Eliakim [Jehoiakim] (2 Kings 24:6)
Zerubbabel_2: returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7), son of Shealtiel (Ezra 3:2)
Abihud_2: son of Zerubbabel in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:13)
Eliakim_4: son of Abihud in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:13)
Azor_1: son of Eliakim in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:13)
Zadok_7: son of Azor in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:14)
Achim_1: son of Zadok in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:14)
Eliud_1: son of Achim in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:14)
Eleazar_9: son of Eliud in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:15)
Matthan_1: son of Eleazar in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:15)
Jacob_2: son of Matthan in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:15)
Joseph_6: son of Jacob in the lineage of the Messiah (Matthew 1:16)
Mary_1: wife of Joseph, and mother of the Messiah (Matthew 1:16)
